name: Nellis AFB
description: Home of the U.S. Air Force Warfare Center, 57th Wing, and RED FLAG — the Air Force's premier combat training exercise. The largest combat-coded fighter base in the Air Force.

currentNotifications.title: RED FLAG Training Exercise
currentNotifications.body: RED FLAG exercises bring multinational flight operations. Expect increased traffic and possible gate delays during exercise periods.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records. REAL ID required. Trusted Traveler suspended — all visitors without DoD ID need sponsor + VCC pass.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Nellis Lodging (24/7) for initial arrival. Military Housing Office for family housing; Unaccompanied Housing for dorms.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 99 FSS, M&FRC, and official Nellis sites for in-processing and RED FLAG support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
